title: Organize PDF – Reorder, Rotate & Delete Pages, No Upload
description: Organize PDF pages in your browser: drag to reorder, rotate, duplicate, delete, add blank pages or another PDF. Free, and nothing is uploaded.
heading: Organize PDF pages
subtitle: Drag pages into order, turn, duplicate or delete them, and add blank pages or another PDF; nothing is uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Every page change in one place
features.text: Reorder by dragging, rotate, duplicate, delete, insert a blank page, or add the pages of another PDF, with undo.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Once this page has loaded, the tool keeps working without an internet connection.

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF on the page. Its pages appear as thumbnails.

steps.title: Arrange the pages
steps.text: Drag pages into order, or use the buttons under each page. Add another PDF to put its pages at the end.

steps.title: Save and download
steps.text: Click Save PDF, check the preview and download the organized PDF.

limits: PDFs that need a password to open can't be organized; remove the password first.
Bookmarks and form fields may not carry over to the new PDF.
Very large PDFs are limited by your device's memory.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Can I undo a change?
faq.answer: Yes. Undo and Redo step through every change to the page list until you save.

faq.question: How do I combine two PDFs here?
faq.answer: Click Add another PDF: its pages are added at the end, and you can drag them anywhere.

faq.question: Can I reorder pages on a phone?
faq.answer: Yes. Under each page there are buttons to move it earlier or later; dragging works with a mouse.

faq.question: Can I use a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: Not yet. A PDF that needs a password to open can't be read here. Remove the password in the app you use to open it, then try again.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
